nodes.label: Manual Payment E2E
nodes.rationale: Student creates order (via test-only API), uploads proof (R2 presigned PUT intercepted because dev has no real R2 creds), waits for the Turnstile token, and the admin approves it; cleanup reverts the real enrollment/earnings side effects.

nodes.label: /api/test-only/crear-orden Endpoint
nodes.rationale: WHY: Phase 2 has no buy button on the course page (that is catalog UI, Phase 1), so the e2e test creates the order by POSTing to this test-only Server Action route.

nodes.label: Playwright getDbHandles Pattern
nodes.rationale: WHY: Playwright runs plain Node (not next dev), so .env.local is not auto-loaded; dotenv.config must run and @/db must be dynamically imported AFTER the env is populated, and the CJS dynamic-import transform wraps named exports in {default,...} so they must be unwrapped.
